reviewerInstructions: It should be reworded to a seagull moves your ball

original.title: Ball moved by a seagull
original.question: A seagull lands on the fairway and moves your ball from its spot. What should you do under the Rules?

choices.text: Play the ball from where it stopped
Put the ball back where it was with no penalty
Add a penalty and put the ball back

original.explanation: If your ball at rest is moved by an outside influence, like a seagull, you must put it back where it was with no penalty.

suggestion.title: Ball moved by a seagull
suggestion.question: A seagull moves your ball from its spot on the fairway. What should you do under the Rules?

choices.text: Play the ball from where it stopped
Replace the ball where it was with no penalty
Add a penalty and replace the ball

suggestion.explanation: If your ball at rest is moved by an outside influence, such as a seagull, you must replace it on its original spot with no penalty.
